name: Shadow Puppets fly as shadow bolts and still hit and proc for the Witch Doctor
contract: Shadow Puppets (500015) ticks every 750 ms for 3 s. Each tick cast Shadow Puppet 801797 from the Witch Doctor,
whose client SpellVisual 1924 is the VoodooDoll02 missile, so a little doll flew at the target. Live shows purple
shadow bolts: SpellVisual 2133 (cfx_warlock_shadowbolt_missile) of Shadow Puppet 802745, the aura's own second
trigger, a dummy with the same family flags, school, targets and dice. The server now treats 802745 as the
damage spell (school damage, magic class, SPELL_ATTR3_NOT_A_PROC, not binary, as 801797 is) and each tick casts
it for the tick's amount, so the bolt flies and the doll spell is never cast. The Witch Doctor must cast 802745
and never 801797, the target must take Shadow Puppet damage from 802745, and De Other Side (802092: 'Damage
dealt by Shadow Puppets now increases your damage', buff 570066, 20 s, stacking to 10, proc chance 100) must gain
a stack from those hits. Before the cast the Witch Doctor has no De Other Side buff, so the stacks come from the

steps.label: Control: no De Other Side buff before Shadow Puppets
Let the 3 s of puppets land
The Witch Doctor fired shadow bolt puppets
The doll missile spell is never cast
The bolts deal the Shadow Puppet damage for the Witch Doctor
De Other Side stacks from the Shadow Puppet hits
